findings.action: Create an event (Create FAB + > Event), then try to delete it
findings.actual: Event detail sheet has no delete affordance; no remove('events') path exists in js/daily.js. Events are permanent once created.
findings.expected: User-created data should have a removal path (delete with confirm).

findings.action: Add an appointment on Home, tap its X delete button
findings.actual: Appointment deleted immediately (count 1 -> 0); only a toast, no confirmation sheet.
findings.expected: Destructive action should ask for confirmation.

findings.action: Open class schedule manage sheet, tap a class X
findings.actual: Class deleted immediately (count 2 -> 1); manage sheet just re-renders, toast only, no confirmation.
findings.expected: Destructive action should ask for confirmation.

findings.action: Add a vault note in Me, tap its delete control
findings.actual: Memory deleted immediately (count 4 -> 3); 'Deleted' toast only, no confirmation.
findings.expected: Destructive action should ask for confirmation.

findings.action: Add a skill chip in Me, tap the chip to remove it
findings.actual: Skill removed immediately on tap; no confirmation.
findings.expected: Destructive action should ask for confirmation (low stakes, but accidental taps happen).

findings.action: Open a sample person profile (Groups > People)
findings.actual: Profile shows a 'Verified' checkmark badge on a fictional sample person. Page does carry a 'Sample' tag and a 'Sample profile...' disclaimer at the bottom, so context exists - but the badge itself reads as real verification in a screenshot.
findings.expected: Demo/sample identities should not carry an unqualified 'Verified' badge, or the badge should be demo-qualified.
